finding_dispositions.note: New subsection 'Augustine: Christ given, and still to be given' in sections/20 reports 84.9 in order: Hoc est quod cantavimus; salutare tuum, Christum tuum; Christ already given and still asked for, as daily bread is; given as man, to be given as God; sons in hope, not yet in fact (1 Jn 3:2); the closing line on seeing Christ as the angels see him, in the Oxford English.
